captions.instagram:
You go to tap Call. The page jumps. You land on something else.

We tested 12,621 Australian small-business websites in Google’s lab test on a simulated mid-range phone. 21.8% did not pass Google’s check for content moving around while the page loads. 78.2% did.

The usual causes are photos with no set size, banners that arrive late and fonts that swap in. The fix is to save the space before anything loads.

Free review at prycedigital.com/book

#webdesign #smallbusiness #ux #websitespeed

alt: 21.8% of 12,621 sites jumped: they did not pass Google’s check for content moving while the page loads, in Google’s lab test.
You go to tap Call. The page jumps. A photo or banner lands late and pushes everything down.
Why pages jump: photos with no set size, late banners and pop-ups, fonts swapping in.
The fix: save the space before it loads. Give photos a set width and height, keep a fixed spot for banners.
